gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Expressive from the first glance, Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its open endings letting each counter flow outward. And Zen Maru Gothic follows as a plain sans that never snags on a closed-up bowl, a single thread to follow.
gen-gf-gabarito-zilla-slab: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, every stroke bold-looking or light-looking but never mixing within a word, with openings that let counters spill outward. And Zilla Slab gives a sturdy, technical body, its bowl-ended curves broad enough to keep a long page moving.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-amulya: Amulya brings modern, generous gaps in its curves and a moderate lowercase height. But Goldman is the one to lean on for large, brief headings, where its wide stance and open-parenthesis rounds can stretch out.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-days-one: Goldman spreads its letters wide with generous clearance and big lowercase against its capitals, while Days One fills the line with rung-like spacing. A larger heading size gives Goldman room to breathe.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-farro: Soft and featureless, Farro hums along the paragraph with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast at all. And Goldman, with its widely set, commanding letters and tall lowercase, takes the lead above it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hammersmith-one: Commanding in its wide, open-parenthesis rounds, Goldman towers over a body that barely lifts its capitals above lowercase. Hammersmith One draws rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, and that steady thickness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-inder: Goldman sets its letters wide and gives lowercase a big height beside the capitals, in round forms like open parentheses. Inder, a sans-serif with little height difference between cases, is the pair's quiet strength.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-magra: Goldman's round forms read like open parentheses. It excels at wide, commanding display lines, while Magra, with a big-bodied feel in every lowercase word, does its best work carrying the running text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-menbere: Goldman stretches its letters wide with generous clearance and bold, commanding presence, making it the voice up top. And Menbere stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord, taking over once the text begins.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans packs its characters close as pins in a cushion, with bowls that stay open on one side and a minimal step from caps to lowercase. Goldman handles bold display lines; the sans carries the text.
